urn:eigenius:core:description: Identity EigenTT term on `formulas:FormulaTerm`. Body is a `program:Var` referencing the bound parameter, so this Lambda has type `FormulaTerm → FormulaTerm`. Realises the typed middle `m` of the Symbolics → IntervalArithmetic Comorphism (D32 §6.2): both endpoints speak FormulaTerm natively, so the cross-institution boundary needs no payload translation. The same Lambda will be reused as `m` for every comorphism whose source and target both range over FormulaTerm — Symbolics → DiffEq, Symbolics → JuMP, etc.

Cross-institution Comorphism — Symbolics → IntervalArithmetic. The triple (s, m, t) where s = `ef_symb_expr` (Symbolics' typed extraction of `SymbolicExpression.term` as a FormulaTerm payload), m = `m_id_formula_term` (the identity Lambda on FormulaTerm), t = `if_intv_function` (IntervalArithmetic's typed reification of a FormulaTerm payload as an `IntervalFunction`). The chain-side formalisation of the operational claim demonstrated by `crates/eigenius-julia/tests/cross_institution_probe.rs`: the typed payload is identical on both sides, so `m` is the identity. Marked `exact: true` — bit-for-bit payload preservation, no semantic loss.
